svg.aria-label: Mohamed Habib Soula, Tunis, Tunisia. Product engineer. Six systems shipped to production in three years. Flutter apps, TypeScript backends and the agentic tooling that ships them, owned end to end from the first client call to the release. 6 systems in production 4 as sole engineer; 3,859 contributions last 12 months; 2 prs merged upstream oh-my-pi · 36k stars; EN FR AR working languages tunis · remote. A bar chart shows weekly contributions for the last 12 months; current streak 29 days. Status: open to new projects.
